headline: Mohawk Industries (MHK) Appoints Paul De Cock CEO As Jeff Lorberbaum Becomes Chairman
summary: Mohawk Industries announced a leadership transition with Paul De Cock appointed as CEO. Long-serving CEO Jeff Lorberbaum is retiring from the role and becoming Chairman of the Board. The changes mark a new phase of executive leadership for Mohawk Industries, ticker NYSE:MHK.
